name: Honey Creek
title: Honey Creek Window Cleaning in Lakeway, Pure Water | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Honey Creek, a small Lakeway street of 3 bedroom homes near 1,800 square feet. About 18 windows each, outside windows $10 each.
h1_em: A small street, a clear view.
intro: Honey Creek is a small Lakeway subdivision of three bedroom homes between 1,777 and 1,912 square feet. CleanzATX knows how many windows a house this size has, and quotes are quick.

sections.h2: What Honey Creek homes are like
paragraphs: The homes here are tightly grouped in size, between 1,777 and 1,912 square feet, and are priced from $600K to $750K. Almost all are three bedrooms. There is no gate and no HOA. With so little variation, neighbors often compare notes about upkeep.

A house of about 1,800 square feet has around 18 windows, using our average of 10 windows per 1,000 square feet. That makes the job easy to estimate and plan, and most Honey Creek owners get a quote in one text.

sections.h2: What Honey Creek windows deal with
paragraphs: Typical issues apply. Pollen from cedar in winter and live oak in spring covers the glass. Trees at the front and rear drop leaves into screens. Mineral spots from sprinklers collect on the lower row of panes.

Homes of similar age weather the same way, so neighbors often share the same hard water pattern. If one house has etched lower panes, the one next door probably does too. Cleaning on a regular schedule keeps spots from setting. Removal for existing spots is $10 per pane.

Honey Creek is easy to run. There is no gate, streets are quiet and one crew can do a house at a time. We use poles to reach any upper glass from the ground, and do inside windows by hand. A single visit covers glass, screens and tracks together if you ask. Some owners pair that with a driveway cleaning by surface cleaner, which starts at $0.18 per square foot for concrete with a $250 minimum.

At about 1,850 square feet, a Honey Creek home comes to roughly $185 for exterior windows at $0.10 per square foot, so the $200 minimum applies. Count on about 90 minutes outside. Inside and out at $15 per window is about $280 for a typical count.

why: Houses close in size, so quotes by text are fast and accurate.
About 18 windows per home, easy to plan and finish in one visit.
Matching lower panes tend to need the same spot treatment.
Quiet streets and no gate mean an easy, quick job.

faq.q: How many windows does my house have?
faq.a: Homes average about 10 windows per 1,000 square feet, so a 1,800 square foot house has around 18. Send a count and we confirm the price.
At $10 per window the exterior of an 18 window home would be $180, so the $200 minimum applies. Inside plus outside works out to $15 each window.

faq.q: Can you do the screens and tracks too?
faq.a: Yes. Each screen is $5 and each track is another $5. Both are worth doing once a year or more.

faq.q: My neighbor had you out. Can you do mine the same day?
faq.a: Often yes, if we have room that day. Text us the address and the time of day you prefer, and we check.

faq.q: What if I see a spot the next day?
faq.a: Send a photo. Our 7 day touch up brings us back free when we are in the area, and your satisfaction is guaranteed.
